channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Matt Barnes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Matt Barnes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen
item.description:
“Matt Barnes, Stephen Jack; all those people were investigated. Gilbert Arenas, Corey Maggette, Cutino Mobley; thousands of NBA players were investigated. They just let some of them go to jail. Some of them, the fed got, like, Tony Allen. He didn't go to jail. Whatever he did to get free.”

Glen Davis on Corey Maggette, Gilbert Arenas, Matt Barnes, Tony Allen, Sep 5, 2026. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Draymond Green on Matt Barnes
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“He 100% would be better off, and they 100% would be better off, if he always played that physical. And by the way — if he played that physical all the time, he’d be much more respected around the NBA than he is. He’s respected as a talented player, but — you saw Matt Barnes say the other day — Matt said, 'Cat’s problem is he a cat. He not a dog.' That’s what Matt said.”

Draymond Green on Matt Barnes, Mar 21, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jared Dudley on Kelenna Azubuike, Matt Barnes, Stephen Jackson
item.description:
“I remember the Warriors flew in as a team to play us – Stephen Jackson brought out Matt Barnes and Kelenna Azubuike,”

Jared Dudley on Kelenna Azubuike, Matt Barnes, Stephen Jackson, Aug 7, 2017. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Jason Richardson on Matt Barnes
item.description:
“Jack had his situation in Indiana. Everybody thought Al was done. Everybody thought I got numbers on a bad team. Everybody thought Baron was done. Matt Barnes was a journeyman. Our personalities meshed together. We all respected each other. We all had each other's backs.”

Jason Richardson on Matt Barnes, Mar 21, 2017. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Derek Fisher on Matt Barnes
item.description:
Frank Isola:Derek Fisher on whether he's thinks there could be trouble with Matt Barnes:

“No I really don’t. We’re trying to win games and that’s really all that I’m thinking about as a coach. That’s my job and that’s what we’re going to do.”

Derek Fisher on Matt Barnes, Jan 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @FisolaNYDN.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Matt Barnes
item.description:
Rowan Kavner:Joerger on Barnes:

“The guys that you disliked playing against the most are the guys you know will be the best kind of teammates.”

Dave Joerger on Matt Barnes, Nov 10, 2015. Source: Twitter @RowanKavner.

item.title: Kevin McHale on Matt Barnes
item.description:
Jonathan Feigen:McHale on Barnes Game 2 trash talking:

“You don’t say anything to someone’s (mother). I never thought of talking bad about Magic's mother. It’s hard enough talking crap to Magic. We all talked smack, but nothing like that. That thougth never crossed your mind.”

Kevin McHale on Matt Barnes, May 7, 2015. Source: Twitter @Jonathan_Feigen.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Matt Barnes, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Mark Medina:Doc Rivers on Matt Barnes guarding Kawhi Leonard:

“I like that he wants to. I don't know if I will. I like that he wants to.”

Doc Rivers on Matt Barnes, Kawhi Leonard, Apr 22, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.
